# Pinned evaluator source archive

These six source files are exact bytes from development commit
`0b6e4fcca3306b9fe98b96a08074e78b4674fd16`. Their immutable SHA-256 values are recorded in
`../expansion_contract.py`; `../verify.py` checks them before using their
identity. They preserve the original producer contract without publishing the
development Git history. This is original Open-Jev MIT code.

The historical private cluster resource policy is not included. Its SHA-256
remains an explicit constant so evaluation evidence must still bind the same
policy identity. A policy digest is not an executable public resource allocation.
No dataset, predictions, arithmetic, acceptance threshold or historical metric
was changed by this archive adaptation.
